name: Cinematic Vignette
author: ShaderStudio
description: Darkens image edges with customizable radius, softness, and falloff.
glsl: vec3 applyVignette(vec2 uv, vec3 col, float radius, float softness) { vec2 d = abs(uv - 0.5) * 2.0; float dist = length(d); float v = smoothstep(radius, radius - softness, dist); return col * v; }
wgsl: fn applyVignette(uv: vec2<f32>, col: vec3<f32>, radius: f32, softness: f32) -> vec3<f32> { let d = abs(uv - 0.5) * 2.0; let dist = length(d); let v = smoothstep(radius, radius - softness, dist); return col * v; }
